title: IAO harness.json
description: Fixed harness variables, read once per process from the repo root. Optional: a missing or invalid file/field falls back to the built-in default for that field. Consumed identically by every port (.NET/HarnessConfig, Go/harness_config.go, Python/harness_config.py, Rust/harness_config.rs). Does NOT contain the verify command, target directory or run identity (those live in .harness/run_config.json) and does NOT contain flow-local constants such as the Development flow's MaxFeatures/StepsPerFeature/MaxReplans, which are hardcoded in code, not externalized here.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema file, for editor validation/autocomplete only. Ignored by every harness parser.

maxSteps.description: Global maximum number of harness turns. The Development flow overrides this with its own larger step budget (MaxFeatures * StepsPerFeature + 8, currently 88) for its feature loop; this value mainly governs the generic host and other flows. Non-positive values fall back to the default (12).

maxInstructionChars.description: Maximum size (characters) of an instruction emitted to the driver. 0 disables this guard. Use it to prevent oversized prompts from consuming the context window.

docsMaxChars.description: Maximum number of characters read from the documents folder (the initializer's brief). Non-positive values fall back to the default (40000). Prefer splitting large documents over raising this.

docsFolder.description: Folder (relative or absolute) containing the brief files read by `start`. Supported source files are Markdown and plain text. Blank/whitespace falls back to the default ("specs").

timeoutMs.description: Per-task execution timeout, in milliseconds. Non-positive values fall back to the default (600000 = 10 minutes). Clamped to a hard ceiling of 600000ms regardless of source — a workspace-controlled file cannot disable or exceed this guard. Can be overridden per-invocation by the parent process via the HARNESS_TIMEOUT_MS environment variable (not by the driver, since the env var lives outside the working directory the supervised agent controls).

contextResetMode.description: Policy for requesting a clean driver context between features. "adaptive": reset when reported usage crosses contextResetThreshold (recommended when the driver reports contextUsage/HARNESS_CONTEXT_USAGE_JSON). "per-feature": always start each feature in a clean context. "never": keep one continuous session. Any other value falls back to the default ("adaptive").

contextResetThreshold.description: Usage ratio (0, 1] that triggers an adaptive context reset when contextResetMode is "adaptive". 0.7 means 70% of the reported context window. Out-of-range values fall back to the default (0.7); the effective value is always clamped to [0.1, 1.0].

contextFallbackFeatures.description: Number of feature boundaries used as a deterministic fallback reset cadence when no context-usage telemetry is available. Non-positive values fall back to the default (1).
